summary: This bill amends the Immigration and Nationality Act to require the President to set an annual minimum of 125,000 refugees for admission, including those admitted through community or private sponsorship, and mandates quarterly public reports on refugee admissions and processing.

scores.thoughts: This bill is entirely focused on refugee admissions, setting a minimum annual goal of 125,000 refugees and establishing reporting requirements for their processing. This directly increases the number of individuals admitted to the U.S. under humanitarian grounds.
